service_name: Complaint Handling System — General Civic Grievance Channel
sub_service: General civic complaint registration and status tracking
problem_type: General civic complaints routed via GMDA's Complaint Handling System
description: GMDA's own services portal confirms a real 'Complaint Handling System, Gurugram' with a toll-free number, WhatsApp line, and email, offering complaint registration, status checking, and callback requests. GMDA is a distinct metropolitan development authority from the Municipal Corporation of Gurugram (MCG) -- both operate in the city with different scopes. No category-specific breakdown (garbage/water/roads/streetlights) or numeric SLA is published on the fetched page; filed under WASTE_SANITATION as the most common civic-complaint type, but the channel itself is general-purpose.
procedure: Register a complaint via the toll-free number, WhatsApp, or the online portal; check status or request a callback through the same channels.
